map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.round(t×actualRatio×h: Core formulas (by input variable): Math.round(t×actualRatio×hf); Math.round((w-tenonWidth)÷2); Math.round((t-tenonThick)÷2)

map.家具榫卯设计：根据板厚、板宽与榫型（贯通榫/半榫/燕尾榫/明榫/暗榫/搭接榫）推: Furniture joint design: derive tenon thickness, width, depth and shoulder width from the board thickness, board width and joint type (through tenon / stub tenon / dovetail / exposed tenon / hidden tenon / lap joint), balancing strength and appearance.
map.不同木材强度补偿：软木榫头易松动，按硬度系数放大榫厚；硬木则可适当收紧。: Compensating for different wood strengths: tenons in softwood loosen easily, so the thickness is scaled up by a hardness factor; hardwood can be tightened slightly.
map.加工放样：给出颊高、肩宽等细部尺寸，便于开榫机与手工具对刀与留肩。: Layout for machining: cheek height, shoulder width and other detail dimensions are given, making it easy to set up tenoning machines and hand tools and to leave the shoulders.
map.示例：贯通榫 板厚25mm / 板宽100mm / 中硬木: Example: through tenon, board thickness 25 mm / board width 100 mm / medium-hard wood
map.榫厚 = 25 × 0.4 × 1.0 = 10mm（板厚 40%）；榫宽 =: Tenon thickness = 25 × 0.4 × 1.0 = 10 mm (40% of board thickness); tenon width = 100 × 0.7 = 70 mm (70% of board width); tenon depth = 25 × 3.0 = 75 mm (full through penetration); shoulder width on each side = (100 − 70) ÷ 2 = 15 mm; cheek height top and bottom = (25 − 10) ÷ 2 = 8 mm.
map.榫厚一般取板厚的多少？: What fraction of the board thickness is normally used for the tenon?
map.常用经验为板厚的 1/3–1/2（本工具对多数榫型取 0.33–0.6 的系数）: Common practice is 1/3–1/2 of the board thickness (this tool uses coefficients of 0.33–0.6 for most joint types). Too thin a tenon breaks easily, too thick weakens the parent member; around 0.4 is a safe choice for a through tenon.
map.软木和硬木的系数怎么调？: How are the coefficients adjusted for softwood and hardwood?
map.工具以硬度系数补偿：软木 1.1（榫厚略增防松）、中硬 1.0、硬木 0.9。硬: The tool compensates with a hardness factor: 1.1 for softwood (slightly thicker tenon to avoid loosening), 1.0 for medium-hard and 0.9 for hardwood. Hardwood is strong enough to tighten slightly, while softwood needs a thicker tenon or a wedge.
map.燕尾榫的 14° 角度有什么讲究？: What is special about the 14° angle of a dovetail?
map.燕尾角通常 8°–14°，角度越大咬合越紧、越不易拉脱，但加工与装配难度也上升。: The dovetail angle is usually 8°–14°: a larger angle grips tighter and resists pull-out better, but machining and assembly become harder. This tool uses 14° for dovetails, balancing strength and ease of assembly.
